questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must NOT be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Notice : Ignore :: Expand:?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Opposites**.

Here,

Notice : Ignore → **Ignore** is the opposite of **Notice**.

Similarly,

Expand : Condense → **Condense** is the opposite of **Expand**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a straight row, facing north. V sits at the immediate left of P. U sits at the immediate right of Q. Only R sits between S and T. Only two persons sit to the right of S. P is to the immediate left of T. Who among the following is at the extreme right end of the row?
questions.solution:
**Given:** P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1) Only two persons sit to the right of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a657d1590d3e66b7105b320374238efe2d2c715d4e799eed6b911a0cfe656d1.png] 

2) Only R sits between S and T.

3) P is to the immediate left of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/086ad7175b449e5db6f7aefd71230ed15eec2b91704a3e16882ee90d6fd7d9b2.png] 

4) V sits at the immediate left of P.

5) U sits at the immediate right of Q. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3cfa72e6f06d5c604bf645677ff024096ed7ac2eaae136e126c9a964b5677ae.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, U is at the extreme right end of the row.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All mangoes are grapes.

All grapes are guavas.

**Conclusions:**

I. All guavas are grapes.

II. All grapes are mangoes.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/334a7f6fdbc8066f02dac1f49b8d16239a77a6cd5c01e543f56d141cd8227638.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All guavas are grapes → Does not follow (As all grapes are guavas. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. All grapes are mangoes → Does not follow (As all mangoes are grapes. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
If ‘A’ denotes ‘+’, ‘B’ denotes ‘×’, ‘C’ denotes ‘−’ and ‘D’ denotes ‘÷’, then what will come in place of ‘?’ in the following equation?

(21 B 3) C 33 D ? = 60
questions.solution:
Given Equation: (21 B 3) C 33 D ? = 60

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 +
 ×
 −
 ÷
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ __**21 × 3**__ − 33 ÷ ? = 60

⇒ 63 − __**33 ÷ ?**__ = 60

⇒ 63 − 33 ÷ ? = 60

⇒ 33 ÷ ? = 3

⇒ ? = 11

Hence, the correct option is "Option 2".
